extracted.name: Clementine-printed gift tags
extracted.description: Got leftover clementines or oranges? Use them to create bespoke Christmas name tags – they’re a beautiful and thoughtful addition to a festive gift
ingredient_lines: 1 clementine orange or other citrus fruit
instruction_lines: Cut the clementine in half and leave it to dry out overnight.

Paint a thin layer of acrylic paint over the top of the cut-side of the fruit. Press the painted side onto the card, repeating until the sheet of card is filled with prints – you may have to reapply the paint. Leave to dry completely.
Cut the card into rectangles around the clementine prints. Hole-punch the top of each rectangle and tie a 15cm piece of ribbon or string through each hole.
Write the recipient’s name across the print using a felt tip pen or marker, and stencil, if you like.
